source_scope: tree.rs only, no CUDA/GpuPlan/Store/quality/evaluator/menu change. First successful advance_street child supplies completed output ranges. Other same-state card children append clones and translate only absolute indices/data offsets. runout_chance source unchanged.
proof_obligations: For a fixed advance_street invocation all child BuildState values and board_mask are identical; no card value is passed into action_node. Preserve all phantom subtrees and52slot SENTINELplacement.
Inductively each completed subtree has contiguous node/child/action ranges and no external child references. All nonsentinel child IDs are shifted by node destination delta.
Only action/chance children_start fields shift; only action actions_start and player-specific data_offset shift. All terminal/unused fields and every f64 bit stay cloned exactly.
Nested first-child templates are complete before outer replay. Templates retain indices/counts only, so Vec reallocation cannot invalidate a borrowed pointer. No unsafe access introduced.

Compute all destination ends/deltas and data totals before mutation. When a whole clone cannot fit node budget/integer bounds, execute original recursive path, preserving errors rather than introducing an early different failure.

Each appended range length is no greater than current vector length. Under current Vec amortized growth, reserve by that length should cross at mostone doubling just as gradual append; require exact actual returned capacities, do not infer physical peak from this proof.

Same number/order/layout of nodes/actions/children and exact two data sizes must be proved on full raw trees, not merely root EV/fingerprint. Validate strict/lenient legacy, aggression carry, all-in/budget/error and arbitrary menu cases before production.
costs_pending: Output copying is required and retained. New local template descriptor, translation pass and allocation order need CPU/process/peak/lifetime checks. No retained hash cache or duplicate template vectors, but no materially-free assertion before measurement.
